response: PowerShell# impact-driven：只对高风险文件登记必做检查，普通代码改动不再卡 Stop。$relativePathForRisk = $changedPath -replace '^[A-Za-z]:\\Code\\', ''$relativePathForRisk = $relativePathForRisk -replace '/', '\'$relativePathLower = $relativePathForRisk.ToLowerInvariant()$isHighRiskImpactFile = ( $relativePathLower -like ".claude\hooks\*" -or $relativePathLower -eq ".claude\agent-router.json" -or $relativePathLower -eq ".claude\settings.json" -or $relativePathLower -eq ".claude\settings.local.json" -or $relativePathLower -eq ".mcp.json" -or $relativePathLower -like "*\block-dangerous.ps1" -or $relativePathLower -like "*\pretool-guard.ps1" -or $relativePathLower -like "*\stop-gate.ps1" -or $relativePathLower -like "*\post-tool-recorder.ps1")if ($isHighRiskImpactFile) { # 高风险文件：继续走原 impactChecks 机制，Stop 阶段必须完成检查。 $impactChecks = @() if ($router -and $router.impactChecks) { $impactChecks = @($router.impactChecks) } if ($impactChecks.Count -gt 0) { $record.impact_checks_required = $impactChecks $record.impact_checks_completed = $false $record.impact_risk = "high" }}else { # 普通代码文件：不登记 impact_checks_required，避免 lint/verify 叠加导致 Stop 全卡住。 $record.impact_checks_required = @() $record.impact_checks_completed = $true $record.impact_risk = "normal"}
